title: NotebookLM mind maps gain prompt-driven customisation
summary: Google updates NotebookLM mind maps with prompt-based customisation, scoping to specific sources or topics, renaming and sharing, and smoother navigation between notes.

research.notes: Documented in Google Workspace Updates and NotebookLM Help pages.

web_findings.title: Use Mind Maps in NotebookLM - NotebookLM Help
web_findings.snippet: Customise mind maps with prompts to focus on a specific source, concept, timeline or goal.
